chapter.verse: Tua ciangin a nungzuite' kiangah zong hih bangin gen hi: "Mihau khat in innsung thuvan khat nei a, ama' neihsa teng tua mipa in thangzat cih thu ama' kiangah kiko hi.
Tua ciangin mihaupa in innsung thuvanpa sam a, 'Nangma' thu ka zakte a koici dan hiam? Innsung thuvan sem thei nawnlo ding na hih manin na thuvanna malgualh laibu kei hong ap in,' ci hi.
Innsung thuvanpa in ngaihsun a, 'Ka topa in thuvan nasep pan hong tawpsak ding ahih manin bang ka cih ding hiam? Naham sep ding lah ka ngap kei a, khutdawh nget ding lah ka maizum hi.
Thuvan nasep pan hong kihepkhiat khit mite in a inn uhah hong san nadingun bangci hih ding cih ka thei ta hi,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin a topa' tunga leiba neite khatkhit khat samin a masapa' kiangah, 'Ka topa' tungah bangzah ba na hi hiam?' ci hi.
Amah in, 'Olive sathau bung zakhat,' ci hi. Thuvanpa in, 'Hih na leibatna lai en inla manlangtak tusukin sawmnga at in,' ci hi.
A nihnapa' kiangah, 'Nang'n ee leh, bangzah ba?' a cih ciangin, 'Mangbuh taang zakhat,' ci hi. Thuvanpa in, 'Hih na leibatna lai en inla sawmgiat at in,' ci hi.
A diktatlo thuvanpa a khuaktaina hangin a topa in phat hi. A hang pen hih khanghun leitung mite, amau' khanpih khuavak tate sangin khuaktaizaw uh hi.
Tua hi a, ke'n kong cihin ah thumaanlo sumlepaia zangin na lawm na gual ding uh zong un. Tua hileh tuate a bei ciangin amaute in tawntung tenna phualte ah note hong sang ding uh hi.
"Thuneuno ah a muanhuaite thulianpi ah zong muanhuai uh a, thuneuno ah a diktat lote thulianpi ah zong diktat lo uh hi.
Tua hi a, thumaanlo leitung sumlepai vai ah na muanhuai kei uhleh kua in hauhna taktak hong ap ngam ding ahi hiam?
Midang khat ii neihsa tungah na muanhuai kei uhleh kua in nomau' neih pen hong pia ding ahi hiam?

To nih a don zo innsung nasem kuamah om lo hi. A hang pen khat hua-in a dang khat it, ahihkeileh khat pibawlin a dang khat neubawl, khatzawzaw hiding hi. Note in Pasian' na leh sum' na na semkhawm theikei ding uh hi."
(Sum a duh) Pharisee-te in hih thu khempeuh a zak uh ciangin Jesu zahpih nuih uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Note pen mite' mai-ah nomaumah a kidiksakte na hi uh a, ahi zongin Pasian in na lungsim uh thei hi. A hang pen mite' thupitsakte Pasian' mai-ah a muhthadahhuai khat suak lel hi.
"John' hun ciangciang Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibu kibulphuh hi. Tua huna kipan Pasian' kumpigam Lungdamna Thu kitangko a, tua sungah mi khempeuh thagum hat suangin lut uh hi.
Ahih hangin Thukhun sunga lai a kikui ciau khat a maiman ding sangin vantung leh leitung a manthan ding baihzaw lai hi.
"A zi ma-in midang khat tawh a kiteng peuhmah angkawm hi a, a pasal tawh kikhen numei a tenpih peuhmah angkawm ahi hi.
"Puannel a sandum nam a silh, nisimin zulim salim ne-in a nuamsa mihau khat om hi.
Ahih hangin a pumtangin meima a vei, Lazarus minnei mizawng khat mihaupa' kongpi ah kikoih a,
mihaupa' sabuai pana anneng kiate nekkhak ding lunggulhin om hi. Uite hong pai-in a meimate liak uh hi.
Tu-in mizawngpa si a, vanmite in Abraham' ang ah puak uh hi. Tua ciangin mihaupa zong si-in kivui hi.
Leinuaic ah gawtna thuakin a om laitak mit hakin a daktoh leh gamlapi ah Abraham leh a ang-a tu Lazarus mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah awng a, 'Pa Abraham aw, kei hong khual in. Hih meikuang sungah gim mahmah ka hih manin Lazarus sawl inla tui sungah a khutme dawn diahin ka leii hong votsak hen,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abraham in, 'Ka ta aw, na nuntak sung a hoih teng na ngah a, tua mah bangin Lazarus in a sia teng ngah, cih phawk in. Tu-in amah in hehnepna ngah a, nang'n gimna a thuak na hi hi.
Tua tham lo-in hih tak pan nang' kiangah hong pai nuamte leh tua tak pan ko' kiangah hong pai nuamte, kuamah a galkah zawhloh nadingin ko leh nang' kikal ah guam thukpi khat kibawl hi,' ci hi.
Mihaupa in, 'Tua ahihleh Pa aw, kong thum hi. Ka pa' inn ah Lazarus sawl inla
sanggam pasal nga nei ka hih manin amaute zong hih gawtna mun hong tun loh nadingun khauhtak va hilhsak hen,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abraham in, 'Amau' kiangah Moses leh Kamsangte om hi. Amaute' thugen na ngai ta uh hen,' ci hi.
Mihaupa in, 'Hilo hi, Pa Abraham aw, misite' lakpan khatpeuh va pai leh amaute kisik ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Abraham in, 'Amaute in Moses leh Kamsangte' thugen ngai lo ding uh ahihleh misite' lakpan khat a thokik phial zongin amaute sangtheisak zolo ding hi,' ci-in dawng hi."Palkhaktheih Thute
